method: AI contextual translation and independent AI linguistic review by the achievement renderer agent (initial 55 strings) and rating-domain agent (two regional-correctness additions); not native-speaker certification.
scope: Best 50 and single-chart achievement image export controls, export status, record-version selection, partial-data qualifications, PB-versus-play labels and canvas labels. Existing global translations are reused.
checks: Compared each translation with its English source, renderer or dialog use, and maintained maimai terminology.
Verified all four translations and exact placeholder multiplicities for every new source; checked no duplicate source keys across locale catalogs.
Preserved canonical chart, version, rank and judgment identifiers, including FAST/LATE and CRITICAL PERFECT.
Preserved manual version selection as regrouping of imported observations, without asserting historical-rating reconstruction or full PB coverage.
Preserved the distinction between a personal best compiled across plays and one recorded play; missing counts are unavailable, not zero.

Reviewed Rating estimate and the community-metadata regional-variation warning in all four translated languages; wording retains an estimate rather than a confirmed complete rating and qualifies chart grouping by region.
corrections: Replaced Current version / Best 15 with New charts / Best 15 because CiRCLE and later can group two releases.
Replaced No play details recorded with Judgment counts unavailable because DX score and timing details may still be known.
visual_validation: The browser suite checks controls and image previews in all five locales at 640, 320 and 280 CSS pixels. This linguistic receipt does not itself assert those browser checks passed.
